established_facts: 36CPU/240GB allocation is not unique to this new request; the old successful mature probe also had it.
The mature probe limits its process affinity to four CPUs; it did not require native allocated ncpus to equal four.
The new DEC1 native_running admission additionally requires Resource_List.ncpus equal four. Current Q resources do not satisfy it.
This is an admission-contract versus native-allocation conflict, not evidence of a GR00T model, weights, training or WBC failure.
unknowns: The exact hook or routing rule producing the rewrite is unproven.
Whether normal user qalter can legally preserve the original requested 4CPU/32GB on this current job is not yet tested or authorized in this fixed scope.
The historical resources_used.ngpus=0 field is not a reliable independent model/CUDA-use metric and is not used to reclassify the old model proof.
